title: Run away
summary: A remembers someone who saw past his polished image: the drawings, music, small acts of care and evenings with their dog. He looks back at the moment he chose a clean exit instead of listening to her.

portal.scene: Jason stands in a warmly lit doorway as a woman and Gấu wait inside; drawing, music, work and memories encircle the room.
portal.motif: The open door and the impulse to leave
